stations.challenge: Choose three things for a good life. Tell your partner why.
followUpQuestions: What makes you happy?
Which do you like more: school or free time? Why?
Who helps you?
stations.mainQuestion: What is a good day for you?
stations.stretch: Describe your perfect day: Where are you? Who is with you? What do you do?
stations.subtitle: What is important in life?
stations.title: What Is Success?

stations.challenge: Two students: one has good grades, the other is very kind. Who is a good student? Why?
followUpQuestions: What subject do you like?
Is a test easy or hard for you? Why?
What is a good grade for you?
stations.mainQuestion: What do you think about grades?
stations.stretch: Name three things a good student does, but not “gets good grades”.
stations.subtitle: Are good grades everything?
stations.title: Grades, Grades, Grades

stations.challenge: Your family wants one job for you, but you want another. Say it nicely: “I want to be … because …”.
followUpQuestions: What jobs do you talk about at home?
What does your family want for you?
What do you want to learn?
stations.stretch: Role-play: one of you is the parent, the other is the son or daughter. Talk about a future job.
stations.subtitle: What does my family want? What do I want?
stations.title: My Dream or Your Dream?

stations.challenge: Name two things your partner does well. Ask one question about each.
followUpQuestions: What is your friend good at?
What are you good at?
What do you like? What does your partner like?
stations.stretch: Say one thing you can learn from your partner and one thing your partner can learn from you.
stations.subtitle: Are other people always better?
stations.title: Me and Other People

stations.challenge: Your friend gets a bad grade in a test. Say two kind things to them.
followUpQuestions: What is difficult for you?
Who helps you try again?
What can you say after a mistake?
stations.mainQuestion: How do you feel after a mistake?
stations.stretch: Say three things you can do after a mistake.
stations.subtitle: What can we do after a mistake?
stations.title: Mistakes Are OK

stations.challenge: Say what you do after school on Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday.
followUpQuestions: What do you do after school?
When do you rest?
How many hours do you sleep?
stations.mainQuestion: How many activities do you have after school?
stations.stretch: Plan a good day with study, friends and rest. Compare plans.
stations.subtitle: School, free time and rest.
stations.title: Too Busy

stations.challenge: Choose one job: chef, doctor or artist. Say why.
followUpQuestions: Do you like working with people? Why?
Is money important to you? Why?
Would you like to work outside? Why?
stations.stretch: Describe your dream job: the place, the people and the hours.
stations.subtitle: What job do I want?
stations.title: Money or a Job I Love?

stations.challenge: Choose three simple things that make a good day. Compare lists.
followUpQuestions: Do you want to be famous? Why or why not?
What do you enjoy every day?
What is one good thing in your life?
stations.mainQuestion: What simple things make you happy?
stations.stretch: Describe a happy, quiet Sunday. What do you do?
stations.subtitle: Do I need to be special?
stations.title: A Normal Life

toolkit.example: Because it is … / It makes me happy.
Me too! / I think so too.

vocabulary.explanation: what you use to buy things

warmUp.note: If you want: a short activity to start.
warmUp.prompt: Choose two: school, friends, money, family, holidays, free time. Say: “I choose … because …”.

ui.lessonGoal: Ask and answer simple questions about you and your life.
ui.levelTip: Choose 3–4 stations. Listen to an example first. Short answers are OK. You can repeat words and use your hands.

presentation.introduction: School, family, friends, money, the future. What is important to you? Talk about it with a partner.
presentation.privacyNotice: You can invent examples. You don’t need to talk about your grades, your family or your private life.
quickStart: Give a reason or an example.
Need more? Open the next task.
presentation.strap: What is a good life for you?
presentation.subtitle: A conversation, not a test
